assessment: The source provides a quantitative study of disorder-free localization (DFL) in a non-Abelian SU(2) lattice gauge theory. The best quantitative cluster is the entanglement entropy scaling in the SS sector as a function of gauge coupling g^2 at fixed mass m=1, with a logarithmic fit S_SS = 2.94(2) log(t) + 1.33(3) at g^2=15. This provides a numeric control (g^2), a numeric readout (entanglement entropy), a quantitative mechanism (logarithmic growth), and an explicit domain (g^2 in [0,15]). The case is authoring-ready.

anchors.support: SS case exhibits a clear linear entanglement growth in log(t) across almost all the coupling values, compatible with an MBL phase.
Cyan dashed line is the linear fit of the g^2=15 curve and corresponds to S=2.94(2)*log(t)+1.33(3).

paper_scope: The paper investigates dynamical phases of a (1+1)D truncated SU(2) lattice gauge theory with dynamical matter, focusing on disorder-free localization (DFL), Hilbert space fragmentation (HSF), and ergodic behavior. It uses exact diagonalization on an N=8 site chain with periodic boundary conditions, and studies matter imbalance, quark populations, and entanglement entropy scaling.
